text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed an 80 million markka median forecast for beverages company Oy Hartwall Ab's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on September 26 at 1600/1300 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Hartwall posted a 42.4 million markka profit.
For Hartwall's full-year 1996 profit, seven of the 10 analysts polled gave a mean forecast of 106 million markka (range 93-155 million). The 1995 profit was 45.3 million markka.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank, Opstock and Postipankki.
